title: Typed native integration operations and composite counits
statement: Use the native finite-coefficient Etale and ProEtale derived operations. IntegrationOperations records the pushforward F, pullback P, actual projection components, and pullback tensor/unit comparisons. CompositeOperations records f,g,fg and their actual compositor and pullback comparison. On closed full domains, IntegrationAdjunction records F adjoint to P(-) tensor L. CompositeIntegrationData supplies both adjunctions, the three projection invertibility and action laws, composition compatibility, and the two coefficient counit formulas. Define the composite twist Lf tensor Pf Lg, the four-arrow trace, the transported composite adjunction counit, and the three-clause CounitFormula. The native wrappers fix every operation and comparison by equality to the existing published construction; their existence and uniqueness proofs are complete. This is a verbatim relocation of the existing typed presentation, without changing any data or statement.
